remarks: WELCOME HOME! This 3 bedroom 2 bath home is the perfect place to spend your time. There is a room off the primary bedroom that can be used for a home office or a nursery. The open first floor offers a living room, dining area that has access to the deck and the stone patio below. The kitchen has a gas stove and is adjacent to the dining area .The lower level walk out has a terrific family room with built-ins and a separate mud room with a stacked washer/dryer. There are 2 double bedrooms with plenty of closet space, 2 full updated baths. The primary bath is on a separate level. The primary bedroom has a large walk-in closet. There is a walk-up attic for all your storage .The yard is great for entertaining. PLEASE DO NOT LET THE CATS OR THE DOG OUT! Dog barks and is friendly.
